evals.expected_output: Lists every project-scoped note (no filters), showing each note's id, first line of text, tags, and last-updated date, then asks what to do next.
expectations: Calls research_notes_search with the project tag in tags_all and no other filters
Presents id, a short label from the note text, tags, and updated_at for each result
Asks the user what to do next rather than assuming an action

evals.prompt: Retag the note about federated learning evaluation on arXiv 2401.12345 — I want it under 'methodology' instead of 'evaluation'.
evals.expected_output: Searches for matching notes, disambiguates via AskUserQuestion if more than one candidate exists, shows the current tags, confirms the new tag list, then calls research_notes_update with only the tags field changed.
expectations: Searches for candidate notes on this paper before assuming which one to retag
If more than one candidate matches, disambiguates via AskUserQuestion using format_note_choices.py-style labels rather than guessing
Shows the note's current tags before changing anything
Calls research_notes_update with tags set explicitly, not text/anchors
Does not change any other note's tags as a side effect

evals.prompt: Delete every note I have for arXiv 2401.12345 — I'm done with that paper.
evals.expected_output: Gathers the paper's complete note set across all skills (quick-read sections, quiz questions/recap, discuss topics), lists it in full, gets one explicit confirmation for the whole set, then deletes each note.
expectations: Searches with no skill/type/section tag filter beyond project scope, to gather every note for this paper regardless of which skill created it
Presents the complete set of notes about to be deleted before asking for confirmation
Gets one explicit confirmation covering the whole set rather than deleting incrementally without confirmation
Calls research_notes_delete for each note in the confirmed set
Does not claim to clean up any local file, since there is none left to clean up

evals.prompt: Add a note to arXiv 2401.12345 saying 'their baseline comparison in Table 2 seems to be missing a strong recent method' — this is just for me, not tied to any discussion.
evals.expected_output: Creates a new note directly via research_notes_create with the given text and the project tag, without requiring a prior discuss/quick-read/quiz-me session.
expectations: Does not require a prior discuss, quick-read, or quiz-me session to exist for this paper first
Calls research_notes_create with the exact text given and provider/identifier resolved for arxiv 2401.12345
Includes the project tag among the note's tags
Does not fabricate additional tags the user didn't ask for beyond the project tag
